title: fix(objectql): a file field reads the same whether or not the projection lists id
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XQccQdv8fPv2TX5Av6ZoDHr)_

Fixes #26672

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：引擎的 `find` / `findOne` 在调用方投影里点名了文件字段却没点名 `id` 时，内部多读一列 `id`，读完后再把它从答案里裁掉（与公式字段扩宽列的裁剪同一处）。
- 为什么改：无权读 `sys_file` 的读者，文件元数据按"拥有该文件的记录"的判决来给，而这个判决按记录 `id` 匹配。投影漏了 `id`，判决就找不到记录，于是有权读的应用管理员在 `select=FILE_FIELD` 时拿到 `metadataRefused: true`，加上 `id` 却拿到完整值（hotclm 报告）。
- 风险与回滚：只影响点名文件字段且没点名 `id` 的投影，多读一列、答案列不变；无权读者照样被拒（两种投影都钉了）。回滚即还原 `packages/objectql/src/engine.ts` 的一处函数和两处调用。
- 先看：`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`（`withFileOwnerKey` 及 `find` / `findOne` 两处调用）、`packages/rest/src/data-file-field-projection-without-id.test.ts`、`packages/objectql/src/engine-file-hydrate-parent-derived.test.ts`（改写了原先钉住旧行为的用例）。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/data-file-field-projection-without-id.test.ts`，预期 6 个用例全绿；在 main 上同一命令 3 红 3 绿（红的是三个"不带 id"的门）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- **`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts`**: a new module helper `withFileOwnerKey(schema, requestedFields, planned)` runs right after `planFormulaProjection` in both `find` and `findOne`. When the caller's explicit projection names a file-reference field (`FILE_REFERENCE_TYPES`) and the planned projection does not carry `id`, it appends `id` to what the driver is asked for and adds `id` to the widened set. The existing `withoutFormulaWidening` / `rowsWithoutFormulaWidening` cut at the `return` (after the middleware chain) then trims it, so the answer carries exactly the columns the caller named. Every consumer in between (formulas, `expand`, file-reference hydration, `afterFind` hooks, the secret mask, the middlewares' post-phase) reads the row with its `id`, which is what `resolveFileReferences` → `serveRefusedFileHydration` → `readParentDerivedFiles` need to match a file to the record that owns it.
- The parent-derived verdict, the refused marker and the caller's own `sys_file` read are untouched: a reader the field-owned verdict refuses still gets `{ id, metadataRefused: true }`, a copied-in id is still refused on the record it was copied into.
- Docblocks: `readParentDerivedFiles` no longer cites "a projection that left out `id`" as a reason for an empty map, and `withoutFormulaWidening` names the second thing it cuts.
- **Changeset** `@objectstack/objectql` `patch`.

### Which doors share the fix

The fix is in the engine's two read verbs, so every door that reads through them shares it; no door holds its own copy of the hydration.

| Door | Path to the hydration | Shares the fix |
|---|---|---|
| REST `GET /api/v1/data/:object?select=` | `crud-routes.ts` → `protocol.findData` → `engine.find` | yes (pinned) |
| REST `POST /api/v1/data/:object/query` `fields` | `crud-routes.ts` → `protocol.findData` → `engine.find` | yes (pinned) |
| REST `GET /api/v1/data/:object/:id?select=` | `crud-routes.ts` → `protocol.getData` → `engine.findOne` | yes (pinned) |
| Dispatcher data domain (list, query, by-id) | `runtime/src/domains/data.ts` → `action-execution.ts` `callData` → `protocol.findData` / `protocol.getData` → the same engine verbs | yes (same call, read not re-pinned) |
| `expand` sub-reads | `expandRelatedRecords` → `this.find` with the join key `id` already added to a nested projection | already carried `id`; now also covered by the engine rule |
| In-process `engine.find` / `engine.findOne` with `fields` | direct | yes (pinned in objectql and service-storage) |

## Tests

- **New** `packages/rest/src/data-file-field-projection-without-id.test.ts` on the composed REST harness (`RestServer` → `ObjectStackProtocolImplementation` → `ObjectQL` → `SqlDriver` on better-sqlite3), a reader refused `sys_file` read whose field-owned verdict allows it:
  - `GET /data/:object?select=attachment`, `POST /data/:object/query { fields: ['attachment'] }`, `GET /data/:object/:id?select=attachment`: the full file value, and no `id` key on the row.
  - CONTROL `select=id,attachment` (all three doors): unchanged.
  - CONTROL a caller the verdict refuses: `{ id, metadataRefused: true }` with and without `id`, all three doors.
- **Changed** `packages/objectql/src/engine-file-hydrate-parent-derived.test.ts`: the case "a read whose projection leaves out id cannot name its owner record, so every id keeps the marker" pinned exactly the defect this card fixes; it now pins that such a read gets the same verdict as `fields: ['id', 'attachment']` (owner hydrates, a copied-in id stays refused, rows carry only `attachment`), on `find` and `findOne`, plus a new refused-reader control.
- **Added case** in `packages/services/service-storage/src/field-owned-file-hydration-door-agreement.test.ts`, against the REAL field-owned verdict `StorageServicePlugin` hands the engine: an id-less projection hydrates the owned file and the delegate-allowed file, and keeps the marker for the delegate's deny and for a copied-in id the reader cannot read.

## Acceptance notes

- The `id` is read for any explicit projection naming a file field, whichever arm the hydration takes (the caller's own `sys_file` read does not need it). Narrowing it to the refused arm would need the admission answer before the driver read; one extra column on such reads was preferred over a second planning path.
- An `afterFind` hook on such a read now sees `id` on the row, and has it cut afterwards, exactly as for a projection naming a formula field (#22300).

## Verification

All readings below are on head `6ea02bc0` unless a line says otherwise.

<details><summary>Red first on main, green after (REST door test)</summary>

- On `main` (`1708115e`, objectql `dist/` built from main): `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest exec vitest run src/data-file-field-projection-without-id.test.ts` answered **3 failed, 3 passed**. The three reds are the three id-less doors: `expected [ { attachment: { …(2) } } ] to deeply equal [ { attachment: { …(5) } } ]` (list and query) and `expected { id: 'f_26672_owned', …(1) } to deeply equal { id: 'f_26672_owned', …(4) }` (by-id). The three greens are the refusal it starts from, the `select=id,…` control and the refused-reader control.
- After the fix (objectql rebuilt): **6 passed (6)**.
</details>

<details><summary>Ablation (objectql suite, resolves src)</summary>

`engine.ts` replaced on disk with its `main` blob under a restoring `trap` (mutant `withFileOwnerKey` count 0): `engine-file-hydrate-parent-derived.test.ts` answered **1 failed, 16 passed**, the red being the id-less case; the refused-reader control stayed green, as it should. Restore proven by the HEAD blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD` (`RESTORED-OK`).
</details>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql test`: Test Files 475 passed (475), Tests 8850 passed (8850).

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-storage test`: Test Files 70 passed (70), Tests 1258 passed (1258).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/objectql --filter @objectstack/rest --filter @objectstack/service-storage run typecheck`: exit 0 (each package's `check:test-typecheck` OK).
- Those suites ran on `845325d3`; the only later change is one `as any` removed from the new REST test, re-run on `6ea02bc0` with `rest` typecheck and the file (6 passed).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` over `packages/objectql/src`, the new REST test and `packages/services/service-storage/src`: exit 0.

Run on `6ea02bc0`, every exit code captured before any pipe: **67 of 67 exit 0**. `dispatch-gates --ran` reconciles: 67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN. The first run on `845325d3` was red on `check:query-options-erasure` (the new test's direct `sys_file` read carried an `as any`, test surface 236 → 237); the cast was removed, so the test surface is back at 236.
